inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Grease on the gears, steam in the air,
Feeding the beast with a collective prayer.
They sell us the dark, we buy it in bulk,
Choking on smoke, drinking from the cup.
The machine hums low, it eats the weak,
While we dance on the edge of the concrete peak.

[Chorus]
Panic engine, turning the wheel!
Fear is the fuel, terror is real!
Laugh at the noise and the gears will stall!
Break the machine, we stand up tall!

[Verse]
Found the blueprints in the rusted drain,
A simple joke to break the chain.
He opened his mouth, let a giggle burst,
Screaming laughter tearing the engine apart.
The pistons jammed, the pistons died,
The panic engine couldn't hide.

[Chorus]
Panic engine, turning the wheel!
Fear is the fuel, terror is real!
Laugh at the noise and the gears will stall!
Break the machine, we stand up tall!

[Bridge]
Silence falls, the smoke clears up,
The giant clock hits a sudden stop.
No more fear to keep it running,
The city breathes, the lesson is coming.

[Solo]

[Chorus]
Panic engine, turning the wheel!
Fear is the fuel, terror is real!
Laugh at the noise and the gears will stall!
Break the machine, we stand up tall!

[Outro]
Gears grind down, final crash,
The panic engine is ash.
